question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank and make the sentence meaningful.

Before retiring, Kaul had been teaching physics at the university for three ________________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**decades**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**decades**" refers to a period of ten years.
 
• The sentence mentions teaching physics at the university for three ________________, which implies a duration of time.
 
• The other options: "**decimals**," "**decadents**," and "**edecamals**" are either unrelated or incorrectly spelt.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Before retiring, Kaul had been teaching physics at the university for three decades__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Decimals (दशांश)**: refers to numbers expressed in the base-10 number system, which is unrelated to the context.
 
• **Decadents (पतनोन्मुख)**: refers to people characterized by self-indulgence and moral decay, which is irrelevant here.
 
• **Edecamals**: This is not a valid English word.
